name: Usami Haru
source: A girl who transferred into [url=/c305]Kyousuke's[/url] class in search of clues on her hunt for [url=/c327]Maou[/url]. When the time calls for it, she's a great detective with sharp reasoning. Although she is highly intelligent, her odd behaviour and speech causes confusion in those around her. She has a cute side since she loves penguins and makes her own penguin costumes. She comes to rely on Kyousuke in her investigations.
